digest.component_or_area: LLM framework documentation and gateway observability
propositions: The llm.headers gateway-observability surface and its rebar-specific value grammar are undocumented, preventing operator discovery and creating security risk of committed credentials.

llm.headers resolution layers, precedence rules, ${env:...} and ${run:...} grammar with closed vocabulary (trace_id, ticket_id, operation), and rejected header names (authorization, x-api-key, cookie, host, proxy-authorization) must be documented in docs/config.md alongside other LLM knobs.
Gateway observability recipe with at least two distinct gateways and nginx underscore-stripping caveat must be added to docs/llm-framework.md to prevent silent header loss and vendor bias.

Security guidance must explicitly state that header values may reference ${env:...} to avoid credential commits, authentication names are rejected because vendor SDKs merge caller headers last, and values are never recorded (only names via header_names field).
Bedrock provider limitation must be documented: headers do not reach the Bedrock path at pinned pydantic-ai, despite base_url gate exclusion, so operators must not discover this gap empirically.
